question: In Fall 2025, do 15-213 (Section W: Thursday 11:30–12:20) and 15-112 (Section W: Tuesday, Thursday, Sunday 11:30–12:45) have a time conflict?
expected_answer: Yes — both courses meet on Thursday from 11:30, with 15-213 running to 12:20 and 15-112 running to 12:45. A student cannot register for both sections simultaneously because they overlap on Thursday during the 11:30–12:20 window.
reasoning_type: Direct time overlap detection across two courses
common_mistake: Only checking one day of the week (missing that Thursday is the conflict day); comparing course names rather than specific section meeting times
needs_verification: Confirm 15-213 Section W meeting time in Fall 2025 is Thursday 11:30–12:20
Confirm 15-112 Section W meeting time in Fall 2025 is Tuesday/Thursday/Sunday 11:30–12:45
